entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Church of the Nativity of Jesus Christ is a historical fortified parish church located in the center of Ternopil, Ukraine, at 22 Ruska Street. It belongs to the architectural style known as a conch church. It has been declared a monument of architecture of national significance.
